Player Data

Every number on one player · weeks 1–7

460 players: everyone with a game through week 7. PPR rank = points per game among players at his position with 2+ games. Graded weeks: the consensus rank before the week → where he actually finished at his position; vs proj = PPR points minus the consensus projection. Unrealized air yards = air yards on all his targets minus the air yards on the balls he caught. Yards before/after contact, broken tackles, drops, bad throws and pressures are charted by PFR; separation, YAC over expected, rush yards over expected, 8+ box %, time to throw and aggressiveness are Next Gen Stats (only weeks over their minimums count). The route tree shows where his targets went (depth and side of every target); the route actually run isn't public for this season.

With-Bets Standings

The side game · real record vs. record with bets

Lines: NFL games use posted sportsbook lines; our league's lines come from each team's best projected lineup; player props are set at his projection or recent per-game average, so each side is close to a coin flip, and touchdown odds come from his scoring rate. Up to 6 legs per slip, winnings capped at 150 points per slip. Each leg locks at its game's kickoff; league matchups lock at the week's first kickoff. A pushed or voided leg (player inactive) drops out of the parlay. Bets are recorded by the league office with the same team sign-in as Rule Changes.
